requirements_summary: Private VPC deployment for inference platform hosting customer PII and transaction data. Must support Okta SAML SSO, HSM-backed KMS, audit logging to customer SIEM, and strict US data residency (US-East). Require SIG/CAIQ + vendor risk intake packet; expect shared-responsibility matrix defining control plane vs data plane responsibilities. Primary workloads: low-latency chat (p95 <150ms), batch embeddings (5k/day), reranking. Compliance: SOC2 Type II, ISO27001. Retention and e-discovery controls requested.
notes:
- Security-first financial customer. Very strict residency: 'data must remain in US-East, no multi-region backups without approval.'
- KMS: preference for customer-managed keys in HSM; will require key rotation policy and proof of HSM attestations.
- SIG/CAIQ: security team expects fully-populated SIG v2025 + CAIQ snapshot; legal wants SLAs around uptime and incident response (for fallbacks to dedicated).
- Audit logging: export to Splunk/Datadog SIEM via customer VPC peering; retention 7+ years for transaction logs, 1 year for request-level logs unless flagged.
- Shared responsibility: infra team insists Redwood must document control plane network egress, list of endpoints, and minimal port/URL allowlist for customer firewall.
- POC asks: 4-week evaluation in customer VPC, sample dataset redacted, 100 qps chat sim, embeddings throughput test. Success metrics: latency <150ms p95 for small context, no data persistence in Redwood control plane, successful KMS operations from customer KMS.
- Quote from CISO: 'We will not accept any vendor who cannot show HSM-backed KMS and a clear shared-responsibility spreadsheet.'
- Procurement note: initial ARR target in RFP ~ $200k-$400k y1; room for expansion if privacy controls validated.
- Risk intake green flags: SOC2 report available, encryption at rest, private control plane option. Remaining open: CAIQ clarifications on key management and cross-region backups.
- Action items: complete SIG/CAIQ responses (owner: Maya) by 2026-03-15; schedule KMS architecture review with security by 2026-03-18.
